kill.explanation: The host machine: the agent ran a recursive, forced delete aimed at /, the home directory or a variable that expands to it.

incidents.title: Path outside the workspace
incidents.explanation: The workspace boundary: a tool call resolved to a path outside the agent's work directory (system directories such as /usr are allowed).
incidents.why_it_matters: Warning only. Frequent and usually benign (the work directory's parent, a tool's cache); check the evidence path.

incidents.title: Recursive delete of the filesystem root or home
incidents.explanation: The host machine: the agent ran a recursive, forced delete aimed at /, the home directory or a variable that expands to it.
incidents.why_it_matters: One such command can destroy the owner's files and the harness itself. The run is killed at once.
